notes.title: V1.0.2
notes.notes:
-Made it so new players will be automatically put into the tutorial.

-Made it so the[b] reset save[/b] button actually works

notes.title: V 1.0.1
notes.notes:
-Added Version number to top right of main menu (Currently 1.0.1)

-Fixed issue with boss maker where no attacks could be chosen

notes.title: More Content and QOL
notes.notes:
Here's what we got in this update:

[u][b]Upgrades[/b][/u]
-Added the final upgrade to the savory category
-Added the new bitter category with 8 new upgrades
-Slightly modified the upgrade UI
-Changed how ability randomization works to be more fun

[u][b]Boss Attacks[/b][/u]
-Added a ton of new boss attacks
-Added a ton of combos
-Readded boss randomization new and improved

[u][b]Meta Progression[/b][/u]
-Added new leaves of Power

There is also many small tweaks and bugfixes.

notes.title: The Replayability Update
notes.notes:
There are so many small changes and bugfixes I cant even list them all here but here's what you can look forward to.

[b]Meta Progression Rework[/b]
-Reworked all existing meta progression
-Added two more leaves of Power
-Added descriptions for each Leaf

[b]Boss Improvements[/b]
-Added SO many boss attacks
-[u][b]Temporarily[/b][/u] removed randomization of boss attacks to focus on handpicked combos
-[b]POTATO[/b]
-Added better descriptions for boss attacks

[b]Abilities[/b]
-Reworked Ability UI
-Added many new Abilities

[b]Tutorial[/b]
-Added tutorial button to menu
-Added tutorial
-Currently only supports controller (That is the intended way to play anyway)

[b]Boss Maker[/b]
-Added boss maker teleporter to Hub World
-Added UI for creating custom boss combos

And so.. so much more!

notes.title: V0.1.1 - Scaling boss health and bugfixes!
notes.notes:
[u][b]Additions:[/b][/u]
-Added scaling to the bosses health so he gets more tanky the further you go
-Stopped Multiple of the same upgrade from appearing per choice

[u][b]Bugfixes:[/b][/u]
-Fixed whitehole doing nothing
-Fixed shout attack not being affected by Caramel Coat
-Fixed sweet punch not changing speeds while not punching
-Fixed sweet heavy's speed not resetting until the next swing

More Upgrades coming soon!
